15-Day Best of Turkey & Egypt: Cappadocia to the Nile
summary:
The 15-Day Best of Turkey & Egypt Tour gives Turkey’s archaeological highlights more room before continuing into Egypt. Explore Istanbul and Cappadocia, then travel west to Pamukkale and ancient Ephesus before flying to Cairo. After visiting the Pyramids of Giza and Cairo’s historic sites, continue south to Aswan for a three-night full-board Nile cruise ending in Luxor, with guided visits to major monuments along the river.
The year-round package is designed for independent travelers and includes selected 4-star hotels, breakfast, cruise meals, professional local guides, airport transfers, entrance fees, scheduled sightseeing and five domestic flights.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Istanbul
itinerary.text:
Upon arrival at Istanbul Airport (IST or SAW), meet our representative and transfer to your hotel.
Check-in is available after 14:00. The remainder of the day is at leisure. Overnight in Istanbul.

itinerary.title: Istanbul Oldcity Walking Tour
itinerary.text: After breakfast at 08:30, enjoy a guided tour of Istanbul. Visit the historic Hippodrome of Constantinople, including the Egyptian Obelisk, Serpentine Column, and Fountain of Wilhelm II. Continue to the iconic Blue Mosque and the magnificent Hagia Sophia. After lunch, explore the atmospheric Basilica Cistern, famous for its ancient columns and underground beauty. Overnight in Istanbul.

itinerary.title: Bosphorus Cruise- Flight to Cappadocia
itinerary.text: After breakfast at 08:30, visit the historic Spice Bazaar, also known as the Egyptian Bazaar, famous for its colorful spices, sweets, and local products since 1665. Continue with a memorable Bosphorus cruise, sailing between Europe and Asia along one of the world’s most scenic waterways. After the tour, transfer to the airport at 15:00 for your flight to Nevsehir at 18:45. Upon arrival at 20:10, and transfer to your hotel. Overnight in Cappadocia.

itinerary.title: North Cappadocia Tour
itinerary.text:
Optional: Early morning hot air balloon ride over Cappadocia.
After breakfast at 10:00, enjoy a full-day tour of North Cappadocia. Visit Uchisar Castle for panoramic views, followed by Rose Valley, Pasabag, and the Zelve Open Air Museum, famous for fairy chimneys and cave dwellings. After lunch, continue to Devrent Valley and Three Beauties, then visit the charming towns of Urgup and Avanos, known for traditional pottery. After the tour, return to the hotel. Overnight in Cappadocia.

itinerary.title: South Cappadocia Tour- Flight to Izmir
itinerary.text: After breakfast at 09:00, enjoy a full-day tour of South Cappadocia. Visit Ortahisar Castle, the former Greek village of Mustafapaşa, and the Roman ruins of Sobesos Ancient City. Continue to Soğanlı Valley for a scenic walk through its cave churches, followed by lunch. After lunch, explore Kaymakli Underground City, one of Cappadocia’s most famous underground settlements. After the tour, transfer to Kayseri Airport for your flight to Izmir at 22:50. Upon arrival at 00:20, meet and transfer to Kusadasi. Overnight in Kusadasi.

itinerary.title: Tour of Ephesus and House of Virgin Mary
itinerary.text: After breakfast at 09:00, enjoy a guided tour of Ephesus, visiting highlights such as the Odeon, Library of Celsus, Temple of Hadrian, Fountain of Trajan, and the Great Theatre. Continue to the ruins of the Temple of Artemis, followed by lunch and a visit to the House of the Virgin Mary. Overnight in Kusadasi.

itinerary.title: Pamukkale Tour- Flight to Istanbul
itinerary.text: After breakfast at 07:30, depart for Pamukkale to explore its famous white travertine terraces and the ancient city of Hierapolis. Guests may also swim at the famous Cleopatra Antique Pools (optional, extra entrance fee applies). After the tour, transfer to Denizli Airport for your flight to Istanbul at 21:15. Upon arrival at 22:35, meet and transfer to your hotel. Overnight in Istanbul.

itinerary.title: Istanbul to Cairo by Flight.
itinerary.text:
Breakfast. Check-out and transfer to Istanbul Airport for your flight to Cairo (14:00–15:15).
Upon arrival, transfer to your hotel. The remainder of the day is at leisure. Overnight in Cairo.

itinerary.title: Pyramids and Sphinx Tour
itinerary.text: Meet your guide and visit Memphis, the ancient capital of Egypt, and see the impressive statue of Ramesses II. Continue to Saqqara to explore the famous Pyramid of Djoser. Afterwards, visit the legendary Giza pyramid complex and admire the iconic Great Sphinx of Giza. Overnight in Cairo.

itinerary.title: Tour Of Egyptian Museum, Old Cairo
itinerary.text: Breakfast at the hotel in Cairo. Visit the impressive Grand Egyptian Museum and the historic Cairo Citadel, including the beautiful Mosque of Muhammad Ali. Continue to explore Old Cairo with visits to the The Hanging Church and Saints Sergius and Bacchus Church (Abu Serga Church). End the day at the famous Khan el-Khalili Bazaar. Overnight in Cairo.

itinerary.title: Flight to Aswan- Nile Cruise
itinerary.text: Early breakfast box and transfer to the airport for your morning flight from Cairo to Aswan (06:30–07:50). Upon arrival, meet your guide and transfer to board your 3-night Nile River cruise before lunch. Begin sightseeing in Aswan with a visit to the impressive Aswan High Dam, followed by the beautiful Philae Temple located on Agilkia Island and dedicated to the goddess Isis. Return to the cruise ship for dinner. Overnight on board the Nile cruise.

itinerary.title: Nile Cruise- Visit Kom Ombo and Edfu
itinerary.text: Sail to Kom Ombo and visit the Temple of Kom Ombo, dedicated to the crocodile god Sobek. Continue sailing to Edfu and explore the remarkably preserved Temple of Edfu, dedicated to the falcon god Horus. Return to the cruise ship and continue sailing along the Nile River. Overnight on board the Nile cruise.

itinerary.title: Nile Cruise- Luxor Sightseeing
itinerary.text: Sail along the Nile River to Esna and continue onward to Luxor. Begin exploring the West Bank of Luxor with a visit to the legendary Valley of the Kings, burial site of many ancient pharaohs. Continue to the magnificent Mortuary Temple of Hatshepsut, dedicated to Egypt’s famous female pharaoh. End the tour with a stop at the impressive Colossi of Memnon. Return to the cruise ship. Overnight on board the Nile cruise.

itinerary.title: Luxor to Cairo By flight
itinerary.text: Breakfast onboard and disembark in Luxor. Visit the magnificent Luxor Temple and the vast Karnak Temple Complex, one of the largest religious sites in the world. Enjoy some free time before transfer to the airport for your flight to Cairo. Upon arrival, transfer to your hotel. Overnight in Cairo.

itinerary.title: Departure from Cairo
itinerary.text:
After breakfast, check out from the hotel before 12:00 pm.
Transfer to Cairo Airport according to your flight departure time.

faqs.q: What destinations are included in the 15-Day Turkey & Egypt Tour?
faqs.a: The 15-Day Turkey & Egypt Tour covers Istanbul, Cappadocia, Pamukkale, and Ephesus in Turkey, along with Cairo, Luxor, and Aswan in Egypt. This itinerary combines two of the world's most fascinating civilizations, offering an unforgettable journey through ancient history, cultural treasures, spectacular landscapes, and iconic archaeological sites. The tour runs for 14 nights and 15 days.

faqs.q: How much does the 15-Day Turkey & Egypt Tour cost?
faqs.a: The tour starts from €3,495 per person for the 2026 season. The price includes accommodation, guided sightseeing tours, selected meals, airport and hotel transfers, domestic transportation, and six domestic flights. Final pricing may vary depending on travel dates and hotel category.

faqs.q: Are flights included in the package?
faqs.a: Yes, six domestic flights are included within the itinerary. These flights help maximize sightseeing time while providing comfortable travel between destinations in Turkey and Egypt. International flights are not included unless specifically stated.

faqs.q: What kind of accommodation does the tour provide?
faqs.a: The package includes accommodation in carefully selected hotels throughout Turkey and Egypt. Daily breakfast is included, and additional meals may be provided according to the itinerary. Hotels are chosen for their comfort, service quality, and convenient locations.

Yes, professional English-speaking guides accompany the scheduled sightseeing tours in both Turkey and Egypt. Your guides will provide expert insights into the history, archaeology, culture, and traditions of each destination.

faqs.q: Is this tour suitable for first-time visitors to Turkey and Egypt?
faqs.a: Yes, this tour is ideal for first-time visitors. It combines the most famous highlights of both countries, allowing travelers to experience iconic landmarks, ancient cities, natural wonders, and local cultures in one comprehensive itinerary.

faqs.q: How fit do I need to be for the tour?
faqs.a: The physical difficulty is moderate. Travelers should be comfortable walking through archaeological sites, historic districts, museums, and uneven terrain. Most visitors with average fitness levels can comfortably participate throughout the tour.

faqs.q: What are the highlights of the tour?
faqs.a: Highlights include the Blue Mosque, Hagia Sophia, and Bosphorus in Istanbul; the fairy chimneys of Cappadocia; the white terraces of Pamukkale; the ancient city of Ephesus; the Pyramids of Giza in Cairo; the Valley of the Kings in Luxor; and the magnificent temples and Nile scenery of Aswan.

faqs.q: What is the cancellation policy for the 15-Day Turkey & Egypt Tour?
faqs.a: Free cancellation is available up to 60 days before the tour departure date. Cancellations made within 60 days may be subject to fees according to the booking terms, airline conditions, and cancellation policy. Travel insurance is strongly recommended for additional flexibility and protection.

faqs.q: Can the 15-Day Turkey & Egypt Tour be customized?
faqs.a: Yes, the tour can be customized according to your preferences. You can add extra nights, upgrade hotel categories, include a Nile Cruise, add Red Sea resorts, or modify the itinerary to suit your travel interests. Contact Magnificent Travel for a personalized itinerary and quotation.
